description: Rewrite supply_chain_enrichment.py to achieve signal discrimination. Current version produces flat scores (BAD signal quality). MUST: read at least 5 metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars) and apply differentiated scoring. MUST NOT produce identical scores across different MCPs. MUST follow the pure function contract: compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict], no DB writes, no network, no imports of other project modules. Score range [0.0, 100.0]. Evidence dict must list each partial score derived from each field read. Will be validated by enrichment_harness.py against synthetic corpus.
